Class Ui

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.ui.Ui
@ViewScoped public final class Ui extends Object
What a view needs to build its components. Every method is called on the EDT, and every subscription it makes belongs to its view's scope.

    • bind

      public <T> void bind(Consumer<? super T> target, Observable<T> source)
      Calls a target with the current value of an observable, then on every change, on the EDT, until the view's scope closes. Several changes before an update runs cause one call, with the final value.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the value
      Parameters:
      target - the target, such as label::setText
      source - the observable

    • menuBar

      public JMenuBar menuBar(MenuSpec... specs)
      Returns a new menu bar built from descriptions. On macOS, it drops exit(), about() and preferences(), which the application menu shows; then it drops the leading, trailing and doubled separators, and checks the mnemonics of each menu and of the bar's menus.
      Parameters:
      specs - the menus, in order
      Returns:
      the menu bar

      public JPopupMenu popupMenu(JComponent invoker, MenuEntry... entries)

      entries - the entries
      Returns:
      the popup menu

    • run

      public void run(Task<?> task, Block block)
      Runs a task in this view's scope, with input blocking. Outside a command, only Block.NONE, Block.WINDOW and Block.APPLICATION apply.
      Parameters:
      task - the task
      block - what to block while it runs
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for Block.COMMAND or Block.COMPONENT

    • showDialog

      public <R, E extends Enum<E>> Optional<R> showDialog(Class<? extends DialogView<R>> type, E variant)
      Shows a variant of a dialog view, whose resources are its base table with the variant's table merged over it, and blocks until it closes, as showDialog(Class) does.
      Type Parameters:
      R - the type of the result
      E - the type of the variant
      Parameters:
      type - the dialog view's class
      variant - the variant, a constant of the dialog's nested Variants enum
      Returns:
      the result of ok(), or empty for cancel()
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the variant's enum is not nested in the dialog view's class
